properties.name: Energy Parkway & FM 110
improvements: Phase A (2024): southbound left-turn lane on FM 110 (700 ft), northbound right-turn lane (530 ft), westbound approach lanes; collector approach stop-controlled. Built by the developer.
Phase E (2030): install a traffic signal, $425,000. The developer's share is 78.3% ($332,775), the only cost in the study shared with others.
Phase G (2033): modify the signal to add an eastbound leg (eastbound approach lanes) and build a northbound left-turn lane (700 ft). Built by the developer.
